_comment: Declared projections checked before a runtime starts (ticket 0983). scripts/validate-projections.py reads this list and nothing else: an entry that should exist and does not is a failure, which a glob over what happens to exist could never report. `path` is where a runtime looks; `target` is what it must resolve to ($IDH_ROOT = the harness checkout, ~ = $HOME). `installer`, when set, is offered as the alternative repair for a MISSING entry. `runtimes: []` marks an operator-only entry: `idh check` verifies it, no launch waits on it. `required: false` means the entry may be absent on a given machine, but when present it must resolve to its target. Private-overlay targets live under ~/.config/harness/private/ (never committed).
